name: fetch
title: Fetch
description: Download one or many files with curl: batch downloads, URL range patterns, and download history.
author: chrismessina

commands.name: download
commands.title: Download
commands.description: Download a single file from a URL.

commands.name: download-batch
commands.title: Download Batch
commands.description: Download multiple files from a list of URLs.

preferences.name: outputDirectory
preferences.title: Output Directory
preferences.description: Default directory to save downloaded files

preferences.name: overwriteExisting
preferences.title: Overwrite Existing
preferences.description: Overwrite files if they already exist
preferences.label: Overwrite existing files

preferences.name: defaultTimeout
preferences.title: Stall Timeout
preferences.description: Seconds with no data received before a download is abandoned

preferences.name: maxParallelDownloads
preferences.title: Max Parallel Downloads
preferences.description: Maximum concurrent downloads for batch operations (capped at 10)

preferences.name: verboseLogging
preferences.title: Debug Logging
preferences.label: Enable extra diagnostics in the console
preferences.description: Show detailed logs in the console for debugging.

preferences.name: strictRedaction
preferences.title: Strict Redaction
preferences.label: Also hide URL query strings and fragments in logs
preferences.description: Enable before reproducing an issue, then share only the lines written afterward. Masks every URL query string and fragment, including values that automatic redaction cannot recognize by name. Does not change lines already in the console.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
